summary: Develop and validate IFRS 9 ECL models with practical spreadsheet exercises. Build testing evidence and a remediation plan. Explore the 5-day course.
lede: IFRS 9 credit-risk modelling connects portfolio data and forward-looking assumptions to expected credit loss estimates. For impairment analysts, model validators, and finance control professionals, it provides practical methods to assess model inputs, assumptions, and outputs using staging decisions, portfolio segmentation, PD/LGD/EAD calculations, scenario analysis, back-testing, and sensitivity testing. Exercises use supplied data and spreadsheet templates to document validation findings, model limitations, and remediation actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who develop, review, control, or report IFRS 9 impairment estimates and need practical methods for examining model inputs, assumptions, outputs, and validation evidence.
outcomes: Credit Risk Staging And SICR Assessment
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of credit risk, financial reporting, or impairment processes is recommended. Prior exposure to IFRS 9 staging or expected credit loss estimates will help you get more from the exercises. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software capable of working with supplied Excel-compatible files.
